summary: Configured node1 so only root and opsadmin can use crontab. The policy persisted through the mandatory node restart, and crond recovered healthy.
actions_performed: Created /etc/cron.allow with exactly root and opsadmin.
Set ownership root:root, mode 0600, and the correct SELinux context.
Verified root and opsadmin are authorized while nobody is denied.
Safely restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin may schedule cron jobs
evidence.summary: Direct checks show exactly two allowlist entries, the opsadmin account exists, root and opsadmin reach crontab, and nobody is explicitly denied.
